svg.title: The publishing road
svg.desc: The exact tree of files goes to a judgment mind’s verdict and the owner’s go, then publish.py --prepare creates one commit checked object by object. The owner’s own push uses the deploy key and its passphrase; the git host’s rulesets refuse every other write. Five equally spaced plates form a straight vertical road. Below the host, a synthetic rehearsal on a throwaway repository proves the road first, with a labelled dashed arrow returning to the human plate.
